verdict.rationale: Metronome docs confirm free trials and time-limited promotional discounts implemented via rate overrides on contracts (metronome-docs-27, metronome-docs-30), and subscription lifecycle management including trial-to-paid transitions (metronome-docs-6, metronome-docs-29). However there is no evidence of coupon/promo-code redemption flows or trial-end notification mechanics tied to card-network compliance rules. Missing for 10: coupon/promotion code redemption system, trial-end reminder notifications, explicit card-network compliance handling.
